recipes.label: It Avails Nothing
recipes.startdescription:
I have consecrated myself to the cause of the Chandler's Apostle, and the Paths of the Sun now avails me nothing.

[Your destiny awaits somewhere far more distant.]

recipes.label: It Avails Nothing
recipes.startdescription:
Not this path—I must forge my own way to the Mansus.

[Your destiny awaits somewhere far more distant.]

recipes.label: It Avails Nothing
recipes.startdescription:
I must first reclaim the many things that have been lost, and only then may I bring back that splendid Sun from this path.

[Not yet. Perhaps you have only just completed your first exploration, or perhaps you still lack certain ending conditions.]

recipes.label: Ascending the Paths of the Sun
recipes.startdescription:
The Sun has opened the Paths that lead to the Glory — where, it is said, abide the mysteries of eternity and the answers to all questions. Perhaps, at the end of this road, I too shall find my destiny.

[Overcome all obstacles to complete the expedition. Before you begin, you may commit three cards in preparation.]

recipes.comments: 根据进度数量抽取不同的阻碍。
这一配方链接着所有探索日之道途时将会出现的阻碍。

recipes.label: Press On
recipes.startdescription: I cast this obstacle behind me and press on toward the light at the road's end —

recipes.label: Beyond My Strength
recipes.startdescription:
Unable to pass the Path's trials, I am forced out of the dream of the ascent — and all that remains is to wait until the next opportunity comes.

[If the expedition fails, the Dream will be lost; but you may still obtain another Dream card by searching the area.]

recipes.label: Obstacle: The Wood
recipes.startdescription:
The entrance to the road lies hidden in a secret corner of the Wood. I need strength to show the way.

[Meet any threshold of the obstacle to advance the expedition.]

recipes.label: The Wood: Inspiration
recipes.startdescription: I follow where instinct leads. The shadows of the Wood shift and waver, but I always find the way.

recipes.label: The Wood: Guidance
recipes.startdescription: The power of opening knows the art of finding doors. By its guidance, I pass through the ever-shifting Wood.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Gate of the Secret Histories
recipes.startdescription:
The gate's position is fixed, but I still need some fitting power to make it manifest.

[Meet any threshold of the obstacle to advance the expedition.]

recipes.label: A Gate of the Secret Histories: Expose
recipes.startdescription: Merciless light reveals all that is concealed.

recipes.label: A Gate of the Secret Histories: Enticement
recipes.startdescription: Beguiled by a power from another History, the gate has manifested here.

recipes.label: Obstacle: The Path of Atonement
recipes.startdescription:
To pass the obstacle ahead, I must endure suffering beyond common imagining — my will and resolve will be put to the test.

[Meet any threshold of the obstacle to advance the expedition.]

recipes.label: The Path of Atonement: Fortitude
recipes.startdescription: Resolve, keener than a blade — though pain claws at me a hundred times, my steps remain unshaken.

recipes.label: The Path of Atonement: Endurance
recipes.startdescription: Breath held still, thoughts gathered deep — the lessons of endurance will bear me through this trial.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Ascending Stairs
recipes.startdescription:
A long and agonizing ascent awaits. Only a strong and steadfast power can raise me higher.

[Meet any threshold of the obstacle to advance the expedition.]

recipes.label: Ascending Stairs: Pragmatism
recipes.startdescription: Craft and pragmatism are the foundation of all Work — I shall climb with strength that cannot be moved.

recipes.label: Ascending Stairs: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: An astonishing vitality boils within me, so that I cannot stop — and cannot be stopped.

recipes.label: Ascending Stairs: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: An astonishing vitality boils within me, so that I cannot stop — and cannot be stopped.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Surging Phantasms
recipes.startdescription:
Visions of the Glory unfold endlessly before my eyes; I need a mystery profound enough to resist their deception.

[Provide the highest grade of Lore to advance the expedition.]

recipes.label: Surging Phantasms: Mystery
recipes.startdescription: Even unborn, the Chandler knows the truths of the Glory. I shall go forward by His guidance.

recipes.label: The Glory, Close at Hand
recipes.startdescription: I have reached the limit of my own advance — what destiny awaits me?

recipes.label: The Glory, Close at Hand
recipes.startdescription: I have reached the limit of my own advance — what destiny awaits me?

recipes.label: A Spark of Possibility
recipes.startdescription: The Glory is close at hand...... but for now, only a power that verges upon the divine can overcome that final obstacle.

recipes.label: A Spark of Possibility
recipes.startdescription: The baptism of the Glory's light has changed me forever. I have sacrificed the rest of myself for my true desire; my soul and my craft are made new thereby.
recipes.description: I shall devote myself to the Work of the Apostle, to bring about the birth of the Candle-maker...... The road of the Sun is of no use to me now; I shall find my own destiny elsewhere.

recipes.label: A Spark of Possibility
recipes.startdescription: The baptism of the Glory's light has changed me forever. I have sacrificed the rest of myself for my true desire; my soul and my craft are made new thereby.
recipes.description: I shall devote myself to the seeking of the means of change and transformation, refining this body until it can be strengthened no further...... When the scheme is complete, I shall, by my own hand and with might to rival the gods, open the road to the Mansus.

recipes.label: A Spark of Possibility
recipes.startdescription: The baptism of the Glory's light has changed me forever. I have sacrificed the rest of myself for my true desire; my soul and my craft are made new thereby.
recipes.description: I shall devote myself to the welcoming of the Sun's return...... When the scheme is complete, I shall return to this place, journey to the Glory, and bring back that magnificent Sun of old.
